reviewMethod: All 155 steps in 30 group-ten lessons checked in three disjoint local browser runs with real audio, manual continuation, letter help at 320/390/1366 pixels, repeated demos, wrong choices, independent dictation, jump/recovery and lesson continuation. Seven-slot words and eau/eeuw/ieuw combinations retain source tokens and fit without shrinking the type. Letter help and repeat examples never reveal the dictation answer. The existing layout, media, article labels, storage and routes are preserved. 83 steps from the previous group passed again.

layoutRepair.before: Centrum demonstration and eeuw tile overflowed at 320 pixels.
layoutRepair.after: Demonstration slots wrap within their existing area; buttons and slots grow to fit the combination, retaining minimum touch sizes and original font sizes. The active slot is scrolled into view alongside its letter button.

limitations: Browser emulation, no physical phone or learner pilot.
Existing content and pronunciation review limits retained. No new audio, content or media bindings.
